$comment: Reference values for the Claude Connectors Directory portal. Claude does not publish an upload schema for remote connector listings.

listing.name: Terminal49
listing.description: Terminal49 helps users find and monitor ocean shipments and containers, filter and count container worklists, and inspect routes, transport events, and documents. At the user's request it can also track containers, stop or resume tracking, and edit reference numbers, parties, custom fields, and document types. Changes that remove or replace data show a preview first and run only after the user confirms.

primary_use_cases: Find and monitor ocean shipments and containers
Filter and count container worklists by status, terminal, carrier, holds, last free day, or company
Inspect routes, transport events, and documents
Stop or resume shipment tracking and cancel pending tracking requests
Edit reference numbers, parties, and custom field values on containers and shipments
Fix a document's type, extraction, or links
